name: @loontail/launcher-strapi
//overrides: Force a single copy of @strapi/admin across the whole tree. @strapi/strapi 5.44.0 + @strapi/core 5.44.0 pin admin@5.44.0 exactly, but the other @strapi/* sub-packages (content-manager, i18n, email, upload, plugin-cloud, …) use ranges that npm resolves to whatever minor is latest — so we ended up with admin@5.44.0 AND admin@5.46.1 side by side. Two copies means two React contexts created by `createContext('Auth')`; AuthProvider mounts on one, useAuth reads from the other, the selector returns undefined, and admin chunks blow up with `checkUserHasPermissions is not a function`. The override pins everyone to 5.44.0 — the version Strapi's own exact-pin family demands.
